title: 921 KAR 2:016. Standards of need and amount for the Kentucky Transitional Assistance Program (KTAP)
as_at: 2026-10-19 (7-Year Expiration: 2/16/2030; HISTORY ends '49 Ky.R. 676, 1288; eff. 2-16-2023'; FILED WITH LRC November 9, 2022)
what_it_sets: KTAP payment maximum and standard of need by number of eligible persons (1: $372 / $481; 3: $524 / $631; 7+: $964 / $948), gross income limits ($890-$1,754), 45% ratable reduction (payment = lesser of 55% of the deficit or the payment maximum), plus SSA COLAs beginning 2023 to the extent funds are available.
converter: HTML to text (one-off scripts kyrules_h2t.py / kyrules_deposit.py kept outside commons); word-level check against engrossed PDF via pdftotext
terms: Each regulation page on apps.legislature.ky.gov ends with the footer 'Copyright (c) 2024 Kentucky Legislative Research Commission' (no licence, no stated restriction). The formal disclaimer is on legislature.ky.gov, which answered HTTP 403 to robots.txt in the 2026-10-20 statute pass and was not contacted, so it is unread. Administrative regulations have the force of law; as edicts of government they carry no copyright (Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, 590 U.S. 255 (2020)). Only the regulation text, its metadata block (RELATES TO, STATUTORY AUTHORITY, NECESSITY, FUNCTION, AND CONFORMITY), HISTORY, FILED WITH LRC and CONTACT PERSON lines are deposited.
